content: 9legacy has no arm64/aarch64 support: it is Plan 9 4th Edition plus patches, focused on 386/amd64 (boot/getbin pulls 386+amd64 binaries); no 7a/7c/7l and no libc/arm64. Not a donor for the aarch64 toolchain. Evidence: github.com/0intro/9legacy description and 9legacy.org patch list (searched; no arm64 entries). Confidence limited by absence-of-evidence reasoning.
